question.prompt: When proving the angle bisector criterion theorem, given \(PD\perp OA\) at \(D\), \(PE\perp OB\) at \(E\), and \(PD=PE\), which criterion is used to prove that right triangles \(POD\) and \(POE\) are congruent?

solutions.explanation: \(OP\) is the common hypotenuse of the two right triangles, and \(PD=PE\) gives a pair of equal legs. The hypotenuses and one pair of corresponding legs are equal, so use HL, which then gives \(\angle POD=\angle POE\).
solutions.title: Identify the hypotenuse and leg
